title: Platform and automation engineering
lede: My work has been between infrastructure and product: the pipelines I deployed, the clusters I ran and the tooling I built so the team didn't depend on a single person.
body: The last few years I spent on DevOps for a platform of Java and Spring Cloud microservices running on Kubernetes and OpenShift, with Oracle and PostgreSQL as databases and RabbitMQ, Kafka, IBM MQ and SQS as messaging. There I owned the CI/CD pipelines and the pre-production clusters, I handled cloud provisioning and I operated the security controls.

Before that I built microservices and integration platforms for banking and telecoms, and led compliance projects as a technical lead. Since 2023 I have been setting the technical direction for mobile delivery in React Native, using an agentic method: an executable delivery contract, TDD and release gates.
